source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: Each unit with **TZEENTCH LEGIONES DAEMONICA** qualifies if it is friendly and no more than 6″ away from this model. For that unit, each ranged attack its models make gets +1 [Strength](vsdata:core-rule/profiles).

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 8 of 300 sampled combat readings of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.

effects.subject: ranged attacks from qualifying unit models
